create_PddlAction: create a PddlAction with name, parameters, preconditions, postconditions, and task info
check_precondition_PddlAction_is_precond: check if a PddlAction preconditions are satisfied from the current environment predicates
bind_parameters_PddlAction_set_param_val: bind PddlAction parameters to PDDL entities and substitute into pre and post conditions
apply_postconditions_PddlAction_apply: apply a PddlAction postconditions to the simulation info to update predicate states
initialize_task_PddlAction_init_task: initialize a RearrangeTask from a PddlAction using simulation info and task configuration
